name: Jarvis Memory
description: Drop-in replacement for memory-lancedb that proxies all memory operations to the Jarvis sidecar memory service. The sidecar owns the embedding model, vector store (pgvector), and tiered episodic/semantic/procedural storage.

memorySvcUrl.description: Base URL of the Jarvis sidecar memory service. Defaults to http://memory-svc:3031 (the Phase 4 sidecar).

httpTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for memory service calls (default: 5000ms).

autoRecall.description: When true, every agent session injects retrieved memories into prompt context via before_agent_start. Default: true.

autoCapture.description: When true, every agent session captures user messages on agent_end. Default: true.

autoRecallMinPromptLength.description: Skip auto-recall if the user prompt is shorter than this (default: 5 chars).

autoRecallTopK.description: Number of memories to retrieve for auto-recall (default: 5).

captureMaxChars.description: Truncate stored content beyond this many characters (default: 4000).

agentAllowlist.description: Optional: only enable memory for specific agent IDs. Empty = all agents.

memorySvcUrl.label: Memory Service URL
memorySvcUrl.help: Base URL of the sidecar memory service (Phase 4).

autoRecall.label: Auto-recall on session start
autoRecall.help: Inject retrieved memories into the system prompt at the start of each agent session.

autoCapture.label: Auto-capture user messages
autoCapture.help: Store user messages to long-term memory at the end of each agent session.

agentAllowlist.label: Agent allowlist
agentAllowlist.help: If set, only these agent IDs use memory. Empty = all agents.
